title: Kitchen Sink Feature Tour
description: A feature-by-feature workbook that gives every major typed-xlsx primitive its own clearly named tab.
developerHook: Open one workbook and inspect typed accessors, sub-rows, formulas, summaries, dynamic columns, renderers, media, validation, protection, and native Excel tables in isolation.
